model.title: Southcentral Foundation Land Transfer Act of 2025
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-AK)

summary.text: The bill would transfer approximately 3.4 acres of federal property in Anchorage, Alaska to the Southcentral Foundation at no cost, for the organization to use for health and social services programs. The transfer would come with no strings attached, though the federal government would retain the right to access the property if needed, and the two parties would divide responsibility for any environmental contamination based on when it occurred.
